source: Tower of Saviors In-Game Encyclopedia (神魔百科 → 符石狀態)

entries.icon_description: Cracked dark rock struck by a bright blue-white lightning bolt
entries.orb_visual_description: Glowing cyan-white electric aura and crackling lightning arcs enveloping the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 電擊符石一經觸碰 ⇒ 即時停止移動符石
• 如有電擊符石未被消除 ⇒ 全隊攻擊力變 0

entries.icon_description: Cracked amber-gold crystal orb with bright star fractures
entries.orb_visual_description: Pale white-cyan X-shaped star fracture / wind-slash mark across orb center
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw: • 風化符石一經觸碰 ⇒ 即時停止移動符石

entries.icon_description: Jagged frosted blue-grey ice boulder
entries.orb_visual_description: Two-state animated overlay: pending frost aura -> thick crystalline cracked ice cage (冰封狀態) encasing the entire orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 回合結束時，將未凍結狀態的凍結符石 ⇒ 添加為冰封狀態
• 冰封狀態下的符石 3 回合內 ⇒ 不能消除、轉化或引爆
entries.audit_note: Fixed simulator.cpp so IceSealed is NOT falsely counted in 4-neighbor orthogonal peel hits (official spec: thaws after 3 turns rather than by adjacent matches); added dedicated 冻结 brush.

entries.icon_description: Dark basalt rock with crimson volcanic cracks
entries.orb_visual_description: Charred black stone crust split by bright molten orange-yellow lava fissures
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw: • 於石化符石四側消除符石 ⇒ 可解除「一重石化」（首批消除的符石每次只可解除「一重石化」）
entries.audit_note: Fixed simulator.cpp per-wave deduplication: multiple Wave-1 combos touching the same Petrified cell now count as strictly 1 layer ('首批消除的符石每次只可解除一重石化'), while Wave-2+ cascades peel additional layers.

entries.icon_description: Faceted solid crimson crystal gem
entries.orb_visual_description: Translucent jagged solid ice-crystal shell encasing the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 於凝結符石四側消除符石 ⇒ 可解除「一重凝結」（首批消除的符石每次只可解除「一重凝結」）
• 場上凝結符石愈多 ⇒ 敵人所受傷害減少愈多
entries.audit_note: Added dedicated HazardBits.COAGULATED (1 << 23) with immovable + unmatchable physics, per-wave 1-layer orthogonal peel tracking, higher soft clear bonus than Petrified due to enemy damage-reduction scaling, and Board Editor brush.

entries.icon_description: Glowing silver-cyan heater shield with cross emblem
entries.orb_visual_description: Metallic silver-white heater shield frame bordering the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 適用於擁有「加護符石」敵技的敵人
• 「加護符石」不能引爆

autodora_mapping.hazard_bit: HazardBits.PRIORITY (1 << 12, when target boss requires clearing)

entries.audit_note: Movable and matchable normally; skill detonation blocked. Base element classifies cleanly in CvBoardRecognizer.

entries.icon_description: Pink heart pierced diagonally by a downward red sword
entries.orb_visual_description: Washed-out pale bright center tint over the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw: • 消除弱化符石 ⇒ 全隊攻擊力減少（發動龍刻脈動視作消除場上的弱化符石）
entries.audit_note: Added missing BoardBrush.ToggleWeakened ('弱化-') to OverlayBoardEditor so players can paint Weakened orbs directly on the board.

entries.icon_description: Cracked brown-grey fossilized skull/stone plate
entries.orb_visual_description: Desaturated ash-grey cracked stone crust covering the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw: • 如有化血符石未被消除 ① 無法對敵人造成傷害 ② 敵人回復相等於該傷害的血量
entries.audit_note: Fixed simulator.cpp & evaluator.cpp: BloodDrain clears legally across ALL waves (Wave 1 + cascades), not strictly Wave 1, matching official text '如有化血符石未被消除'; added Board Editor brush.

entries.icon_description: Metallic hexagonal naval mine with glowing crimson center core
entries.orb_visual_description: Steel hexagonal mine frame with 6 radial bolts and glowing red core covering the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 爆破炸彈一經觸碰 ⇒ 對召喚師造成指定傷害
※ 【護盾】可抵擋此傷害
entries.audit_note: Fixed solver.cpp to count touching Bomb orbs as touch-damage hits (respecting maxBurningTileHurts / shield budget) so the path routes around Bomb orbs without touching them while still eliminating them via neighboring swaps; updated clearance to all waves and added Board Editor brush.

entries.icon_description: Iridescent purple-blue sphere containing a glowing musical eighth note
entries.orb_visual_description: Translucent iridescent purple-cyan musical bubble aura over the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 適用於擁有「音樂符石」敵技的敵人
• 「音樂符石」不能轉化

autodora_mapping.hazard_bit: HazardBits.PRIORITY (1 << 12, when target boss requires clearing)

entries.audit_note: Movable and matchable normally; skill conversion blocked. Base element classifies cleanly in CvBoardRecognizer.

entries.icon_description: No separate left icon; represented directly by the cyan-black 4-point sundial badge
entries.orb_visual_description: Bright cyan-and-black 4-pointed diamond sundial ('時晷') emblem pinned to the top-left corner of the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 隊伍裝備「時光牌」後，進入關卡後附上「時晷」的符石
• 可被引爆或還原
entries.audit_note: Aligned all localized UI labels from non-standard '光晕符石' to official '流光符石' and added Board Editor brush.

entries.icon_description: Dark smoky obsidian stone cloud
entries.orb_visual_description: Pitch-dark shadowy teal-black orb dotted with faint cyan-green floating embers
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 「邪惡能量符石」不能還原
• 「邪惡能量符石」不能轉化為強化符石
• 每消除 1 粒「邪惡能量符石」⇒ 全隊攻擊力減少
entries.audit_note: Added HazardBits.EVIL_ENERGY (1 << 24) with elimination tracking in simulator.cpp, soft ATK-loss avoidance penalty / hard forbid under forbidWeakenedOrbs in evaluator.cpp, and Board Editor brush.

entries.icon_description: Glossy pale-blue translucent soap bubble
entries.orb_visual_description: Translucent specular soap-bubble membrane wrapping the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 移動符石並消除泡沫符石四側其中 1 個位置的符石可解除泡沫
• 泡沫符石 ⇒ 不能消除、轉化或引爆
• 如有泡沫符石未被消除 ⇒ 全隊攻擊力變 0
entries.audit_note: Fixed board.hpp & simulator.cpp: Foam orbs ARE movable during orb dragging (only unmatchable directly) and track live post-gravity coordinates when bursting on orthogonal adjacent matches; once popped, the orb clears its Foam bit for subsequent waves. Added Board Editor brush.

entries.icon_description: Red-rimmed white circular seal with diagonal sword slash
entries.orb_visual_description: Small red-bordered slashed-sword circular badge pinned to the top-right corner of the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw: • 消除淡化印記符石 ⇒ 敵人減少陽之氣
entries.audit_note: Maps cleanly to HazardBits.PRIORITY (high-priority clear); pairs with Enemy Skill #69 (陽之氣).

entries.icon_description: Glowing warm golden-white circular medallion
entries.orb_visual_description: Small glowing golden-white circle badge pinned to the top-right corner of the orb
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw: • 消除淨化印記符石 ⇒ 敵人減少陰之氣
entries.audit_note: Maps cleanly to HazardBits.PRIORITY (high-priority clear); pairs with Enemy Skill #68 (陰之氣).

entries.icon_description: Glowing magenta-purple floral lotus sigil inside a circle
entries.orb_visual_description: Magenta floral crest overlay on marked orbs
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 每消除 1 粒虛之印記符石 ⇒ 獲得印記力量
• 疊至最高 10 重印記力量 ⇒ 回合結束時召喚師會死亡
• 召喚師死亡後，清空虛之印記及印記力量

autodora_mapping.hazard_bit: HazardBits.RESERVE (1 << 13, when avoiding lethal 10th stack) / HazardBits.PRIORITY (when building stacks)

entries.audit_note: Stack-budget mechanic: players can mark orbs with '保留不消' (HazardBits.RESERVE) when near 10 stacks to prevent instant death at turn end.

entries.icon_description: Glowing pale-blue arcane pentagram / magic circle crest
entries.orb_visual_description: Translucent pale-blue magic-circle sigil overlay on orbs
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 「移動及消除符石」期間外 ⇒ 解除魔力符石位置的「連環光牢」及「暴風」
• 每消除 1 粒魔力符石 ⇒ 增加 3 連擊 (Combo)
• 消除屬性魔力符石 ⇒ 該屬性成員攻擊力 2 倍
• 消除心魔力符石 ⇒ 完全回復生命力
• 魔力符石於召喚師死亡後消失
entries.audit_note: Added HazardBits.MAGIC_ORB (1 << 25): simulator.cpp adds +3 to totalCombo per eliminated Magic orb (accurately interacting with min/exact/parity combo shields!) plus evaluator soft reward and Board Editor brush.

entries.icon_description: Red-bordered circular badge with cyan leaf/flame fan
entries.orb_visual_description: Red-rimmed circular badge with cyan fan emblem at orb corner
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 每消除 1 粒消炎印記符石 ⇒ 敵人減少 1 層炎之氣
• 召喚師死亡後 ⇒ 清空消炎印記
entries.audit_note: Maps cleanly to HazardBits.PRIORITY; pairs with Enemy Skill #73 (炎之氣).

entries.icon_description: Golden-brown circular medallion with lightning-rod coil
entries.orb_visual_description: Golden-brown circular lightning-rod badge at orb corner
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw:
• 每消除 1 粒除雷印記符石 ⇒ 敵人減少 1 層雷之氣
• 召喚師死亡後 ⇒ 清空除雷印記
entries.audit_note: Maps cleanly to HazardBits.PRIORITY; pairs with Enemy Skill #72 (雷之氣).

entries.icon_description: Glowing crimson-framed jagged black fanged maw
entries.orb_visual_description: Spiked crimson-black thorny/fanged aura overlaying marked orbs
entries.full_rule_text_zh_tw: • 每消除刺血符石 ⇒ 扣除召喚師生命力
entries.audit_note: Added HazardBits.BLOOD_THORN (1 << 26) with elimination tracking in simulator.cpp, strong HP-loss avoidance penalty / hard forbid under forbidWeakenedOrbs in evaluator.cpp, and Board Editor brush.
